text:
Molly: Quick sync — iterating website pages for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Focus: clearer activation paths, benchmark callouts, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing.
Alex: +1. Want to see hero variants. Thinking single-line value prop + single primary CTA (signup) and a smaller secondary CTA for enterprise.
Molly: Proposed CTAs: primary 'Try Hosted API' (free credits) + secondary 'Request Dedicated capacity'. For Private, primary becomes 'Request a demo'. Keeps path clarity.
Sam: For benchmark copy let's be careful with absolutes. Draft blurb: "Typical inference setups see 40–60% lower per-token cost with Redwood batching & caching." Legal wanted the word "typical" — ok?
Rachel: LGTM on phrasing. We'll also add a tiny footnote linking to the benchmark repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks — keeps claims verifiable.
Molly: Webinar plan: Title idea — "Serving LLMs at scale: cost, latency, and rollout patterns". Target date May 12. Hero CTA should register users and then surface the product tour + one-page benchmark PDF after signup.
Jamal: Inbound routing proposal (simple rule set):
```
if lead.size == 'enterprise' -> route to sales@redwood.com
else if lead.consumption_estimate > 100000_tokens -> route to solutions@redwood.com
else -> self-serve signup flow (free credits)
```
Alex: We need a tracking param so we can attribute conversions to the hero webinar CTA. Can engineering add utm_source=webinar-hero to the signup link? @deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: scheduled change — will append utm_source=webinar-hero to the signup URL and deploy to staging at 1758104700.
Molly: Timeline: wireframes by EOD Friday, copy pass Monday, set up A/B test variants (signup vs register) next week. Also create a small launch post and partner email for the webinar.
Sam: I'll draft the benchmark microcopy and a 1–2 sentence enterprise blurb for the Private page.
Rachel: I'll own the launch post + partner outreach email. Will share copy in the channel when ready.
Molly: Thanks team — I'll consolidate notes into the marketing doc: https://redwood.in/marketing/pages/xyz :thumbsup:
